snippet.title: Splatoon Raiders – Announcement Trailer & More – Nintendo Switch 2
snippet.description:
Breaking News from Squid Research Lab! Please watch this video for our latest findings, including the first look at an upcoming Splatoon spin-off game called Splatoon Raiders, a free software update for the Splatoon 3 game, and details of Nintendo Switch 2 compatibility.
